mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause or exacerbate renal impairment; risedronate requires adequate renal function for excretion while tobramycin is aminoglycoside-associated with dose-dependent nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and renal function regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; avoid in patients with severe renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min).
